steps.text: Bring destroy field runes or an antidote for the poison fields.
steps.source: Recommended Destroy Field or using Antidote for Poison Fields

steps.text: Go down into the Ancient Temple north of Thais, two floors.
steps.source: Go to the Ancient Temple, north of Thais (Mapper Coords 126.100, 125.171, 7).

steps.text: Go north to the end of the big room and down two floors to the rotworms.
steps.source: Down 2 levels and head North - all the way to the northern end of the large room. Go down to the Rotworms.

steps.text: Follow the long way east, south and east and go down (rotworms, poison spiders, orcs and orc spearmen).
steps.source: Follow this path to the east, south, and east, and go down the ladder. Watch out for Orcs, Orc Spearmen, Orc Warriors.

steps.text: Run through the poison fields (antidote or destroy field) and go down again.
steps.source: This room will be filled with Poison Fields. Once through the poison fields, go down the ladder.

steps.text: Follow the tunnel east and north to the room with skeletons and rotworms: key 3600 is in the pile of bones in the south-east.
steps.source: Follow a small tunnel to the east and then north. After you come to a room with Skeletons and Rotworms, "Open" a dead skeleton in the South-East of the room - you will get Key 3600.

steps.text: Use the well in that room to go down.
steps.source: When you have the key, "Use" the well in that room to go down it.

steps.text: Kill the 3 ghouls and open the door with key 3600.
steps.source: Kill 3 Ghouls, unlock the door with Key 3600, get your reward.

steps.text: The chest with a club ring.
And the chest with a garlic necklace.
